# Redeal

> Real estate deal-finding aggregator for the Baku, Azerbaijan market. Analyzes property listings against district price-per-square-meter averages to surface undervalued deals and market trends.

## Pages

- [Home](https://redeal.holmityd.com/): Interactive search, undervalued property listings, and market trend charts.

## API Endpoints

- [Undervalued Deals](https://redeal.holmityd.com/api/deals/undervalued): Public preview of undervalued property deals filtered by location and discount threshold.
- [Locations](https://redeal.holmityd.com/api/deals/locations): Available Baku districts and neighborhoods.
- [Health](https://redeal.holmityd.com/health): Service health and total indexed listing count.
